6.317 rsInvalidLookupScope
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidLookupScope is a critical error that will occur when a Lookup, LookupSet, or MultiLookup
function contains as its Dataset parameter a value that does not match the value of the Name
attribute of any DataSet.
